description:
APPLICATION FOR A LAWFUL DEVELOPMENT
CERTIFICATE IN RESPECT OF THE PROPOSED ERECTION OF A SINGLE-STOREY REAR
EXTENSION, CONSTRUCTION OF A REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION, INSTALLATION OF A
ROOFLIGHT TO THE FRONT ROOF SLOPE; AND REMOVAL OF THE EXISTING EXTERNAL CHIMNEY
STACK.
decision_conditions: Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class A) - The operations comprising a single storey rear extension would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class A of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class A. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Enlargement of a dwelling house (Class B) - The operations comprising a rear dormer would consist of the enlargement of a dwelling house within the meaning of Class B of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class B. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

Alteration to the roof of the dwelling house (Class C) - The operations comprising a roof light to the front roofslope would consist of any other alteration to the roof of the dwelling house within the meaning of Class C of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.

The operations, removal of chimney stack, would consist of the alteration of a chimney on a dwellinghouse within the meaning of Class G of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development)  (England) Order 2015 "the Order" and would comply with the development tolerances set out in said Class C. The operation would therefore have been granted planning permission by Article 3 of the Order.
